title: Sandscale: sandboxes for AI agents
excerpt: Isolated compute for AI agents. Firecracker microVM sandboxes, workspaces and build machines, started in one call.
content_html:
Compute

Compute for agents, run by us

Sandboxes, workspaces, build machines and your own lab hardware behind one API. No servers to set up.

Sandscale compute, US East. Sandboxes, workspaces and build hosts on our machines in N. Virginia, ready with one API call. Europe, in Frankfurt, is coming soon.

Your lab, connected. Plug in your own Linux or macOS machines with real devices and claim them per run.

Sandboxes

Firecracker microVMs for agent code. Run commands, move files, stream logs, snapshot, pause and resume.

Workspaces

A persistent cloud computer for your coding agent, with your repo, terminals and SSH. Keep working from any device.

Build hosts

Lease a clean build machine for a set time, sync your tree and run over SSH with a short-lived certificate. Wiped on release.

Lab hosts

Connect your own Linux or macOS machines with security keys, TPMs, debug probes and boards, and claim them per run.

Why Sandscale

Why teams and developers run agents on Sandscale

Need more than your plan?

On paid plans you choose what happens when your included hours run out: turn usage beyond them on at $0.05 per awake vCPU-hour, add an hour pack of 500 awake vCPU-hours for $10, or keep it off and new boxes wait for next month. Running boxes are never stopped. Set spend caps per task, agent, project and organization.

Need bigger machines? Pro runs boxes of up to 16 vCPU, Team up to 32 on request, and Enterprise up to 64. Every box gets exactly the vCPUs and memory you picked, plus any burst you set, never more.

Your cloudSandscale

AWS

Bring your own cloud on Enterprise. Self-hosted and air-gapped on request.

Product

Everything a run needs

Start it, watch it, stop it. From your agent, your terminal or the dashboard.

Every run, listed and audited

Start, pause, snapshot and stop sandboxes from the API, the TypeScript SDK or MCP. Every action lands in a tamper-evident audit log.

One platform for agent compute

Sandboxes, workspaces, build hosts and lab hardware run on the same platform, managed from one dashboard and billed as one monthly plan.

Secure by default

Its own kernel per run, the network access your plan allows and your allowlist controls, secrets kept in Vault and never in prompts, and a kill switch for your organisation.

Built for coding agents

Connect over MCP from Claude Code, Codex or your own agent framework. Each agent gets its own box, and you see what each one is doing.

Need more than your plan?

On paid plans you choose what happens when your included hours run out: turn usage beyond them on at $0.05 per awake vCPU-hour, add an hour pack of 500 awake vCPU-hours for $10, or keep it off and new boxes wait for next month. Running boxes are never stopped. Set spend caps per task, agent, project and organization.

Need bigger machines? Pro runs boxes of up to 16 vCPU, Team up to 32 on request, and Enterprise up to 64. Every box gets exactly the vCPUs and memory you picked, plus any burst you set, never more.
